title: LLMSmokeDetector: a two-stage open-source LLM pipeline for tobacco smoking status extraction from clinical discharge summaries
description: Source code for a two-stage large language model (LLM) inference pipeline that extracts tobacco smoking status (Smoker, Never smoker, Unknown) from free-text hospital discharge summaries. Stage 1 generates an unstructured classification per note; Stage 2 maps that output to a single structured label using constrained decoding. Evaluation computes multiclass and per-class metrics with bootstrap confidence intervals and confusion matrices. Companion code for the JAMIA Open Brief Communication comparing six lightweight open-source LLMs (Llama-3 1B-70B, gpt-oss-20B, MedGemma-27B) against the cTAKES NLP system.
